F-RULE.claim: The block subsidy starts at 50 coins (5,000,000,000 satoshi) and is right-shifted (halved, truncating to whole satoshi) every 210,000 blocks.
F-RULE.source: references/sources/bitcoin_commit.txt (Bitcoin Core db0bde16b910: validation.cpp GetBlockSubsidy, chainparams.cpp nSubsidyHalvingInterval / DifficultyAdjustmentInterval)

F-PERIOD.claim: The difficulty adjusts every 2,016 blocks (two weeks at ten minutes a block): one building per period.
F-PERIOD.source: references/sources/bitcoin_commit.txt (Bitcoin Core db0bde16b910: validation.cpp GetBlockSubsidy, chainparams.cpp nSubsidyHalvingInterval / DifficultyAdjustmentInterval)

F-GENESIS.claim: Block 0 (the genesis block) has header time 2009-01-03 18:15:05 UTC; its subsidy was 50 coins.

F-H1.claim: Halving 1 at block 210,000 (2012-11-28 15:24:38): the subsidy fell to 25 coins; 10500000 coins had been issued before it.
F-H1.source: references/sources/blockstream_block_timestamps.json; references/sources/bitcoin_commit.txt (Bitcoin Core db0bde16b910: validation.cpp GetBlockSubsidy, chainparams.cpp nSubsidyHalvingInterval / DifficultyAdjustmentInterval)

F-NOW.claim: At retrieval the chain tip was block 970,440 (header time 2026-10-08 04:41:49 UTC); 20095128.125 coins had been issued through it (20095125 before it); the subsidy is 3.125 coins.

F-FUTURE.claim: 28 more halvings remain with a non-zero subsidy (blocks 1,050,000 to 6,720,000: 1.5625 coins down to 1 satoshi); their dates assume ten-minute blocks and are estimates.
F-FUTURE.source: data/schedule.csv (derived from F-RULE); dates: ten-minute spacing from the tip

F-LAST.claim: Block 6,929,999 is the last block with a subsidy (1 satoshi); from block 6,930,000 the subsidy is 0. At ten minutes a block that is around the year 2140.
F-LAST.source: references/sources/bitcoin_commit.txt (Bitcoin Core db0bde16b910: validation.cpp GetBlockSubsidy, chainparams.cpp nSubsidyHalvingInterval / DifficultyAdjustmentInterval); data/schedule.csv

F-CAP.claim: The schedule sums to 20,999,999.9769 coins: 21,000,000 when rounded (the v0.1 announcement: "Total circulation will be 21,000,000 coins"); Bitcoin Core MAX_MONEY = 21,000,000 is a validity bound.

F-SERIES.claim: One row per difficulty period (3,438 periods from block 0 to 6,929,999): data/periods.csv, derived from F-RULE, F-PERIOD and the measured block times.
